corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward damages artillery during covered eastern passes; Midnight supplies reserved arts during the western return. Physicians sustain actual shell recipients. Source death does not erase born projectiles.
Midnight clears eastern restraint3 using ordinary attacks before his reserved arts window. Steward clears western restraint1 after hostile clearance. Track civilian #3 separately.
Melantha clears eastern restraint4 and stays to intercept later officers. Her final western deployment clears restraint2. Track civilian #14 separately.
Fang holds upper-central traffic. Continuous Steward owns armor and assists runners; Midnight contributes when his own queue and artillery duty permit. There is no returning central Melantha.
Friston supplies three block slots. Steward and available Midnight must remove armor22 early enough to prevent the former runner/armor queue. Actual interception of armor34 is required.
Midnight holds upper-outer traffic. Ansel's active extension supplies scheduled recovery. Midnight must clear his own queue before the western-return artillery handoff.
Permanent Melantha kills lower-outer officers, using attack boosts against paired pressure. Hibiscus supplies direct healing; no Spot successor is available.

formation_structure.artillery_completion: Steward's lower-pass coverage alone is not credited with killing the drone. Midnight's first arts skill is reserved for the western return, when the drone crosses his upper range. Actual artillery damage and death must precede departure from this combined coverage.

economy.dependency: Fang grants require living deployment. Death refunds zero. Missing early income represents failed survival, not an arithmetic correction.
economy.refund_cap_effect: Both late refunds are capped away in the declared surviving-Fang ledger at 99 DP; western redeployments do not depend on receiving their full nominal value.

geometry.ansel: At [5,5] DOWN, ordinarily covers Fang, Friston, Steward and himself. Active forward extension reaches Midnight [1,5]. Melantha remains behind this range.
geometry.hibiscus: At [5,3] RIGHT, covers Melantha [6,5], Friston [4,5], Ansel [5,5] and Steward [5,6], but excludes Fang and Midnight.
geometry.midnight: At [1,5] UP, covers central [3,5]/[4,5] and western-return artillery grid positions [2,4], [2,5], [2,6]. Own blocked enemies take priority.
geometry.steward: At [5,6] DOWN, covers [3,5], [4,5], [3,7], [4,7], [5,7] and [2,6]. Does not cover artillery waiting at [2,7].

medical_budget.implication: Even joint boosts barely match the Steward/Ansel shell pair before other damage. Survival needs finite exposure, initial HP, recovery gaps and actual healing allocation; average HPS does not prove survival.
medical_budget.scope: Capacity only; neither physician can be assigned a forced recipient.

shell_examples.melantha_center: A shell centered on Melantha also reaches Ansel: approximately 1736 total damage. Steward and Friston are outside this impact circle.
shell_examples.steward_center: A 1.2-radius shell centered on Steward also reaches Ansel: approximately 1801 total physical damage, or 360.2 HP/s over repeated five-second casts.

formation_structure.role_elimination: Spot's separate successor deployment and local healing are eliminated. Melantha retains the lower outer lane; Hibiscus directly heals it. Steward's artillery-to-central retreat cycle is eliminated.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only range transformations, capped DP arithmetic, skill recovery excluding active durations and redeploy gaps checked. No simulation or file mutation performed. Full-stage acceptance remains unverified.

Deploy Ansel centrally; Fang must have survived the longer interval without direct medical coverage.
Steward enters [5,6] DOWN and remains through artillery and central clearance. Melantha stays deployed.
Hibiscus boosts the first sustained eastern shell exposure; Ansel retains his first activation for the second exposure and Midnight.
Ansel extends healing to Midnight while supporting the second lower artillery pass.
Midnight activates his first arts skill for western-return artillery assistance and early central armor.
Start the joint late medical window before runner accumulation and final outer officers.
Withdraw Steward only on the plan's required state of hostile clearance and resolved artillery projectiles.
Withdraw living Melantha after the lower-outer queue is empty.
Return Steward west after 2101 frames of redeploy recovery.
Return Melantha west and release the second protected route by destroying its restraint.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly these seven distinct catalog IDs are used; each has rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true.
All deployment tiles are integer [row,col] with cardinal directions. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]], even after device destruction.
Fang survives to each relied-upon grant. No death refund, imaginary replacement credit or unready skill is counted.
Healing follows the current selector. Steward follows highest-defense priority; Midnight attacks his own blocked enemies first. No action forces their target.
Both eastern restraints must clear without lethal civilian exposure. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians, and medics do not heal them.
Midnight must actually damage the western-return drone with arts while Steward's accumulated damage remains sufficient. Ordinary attacks are not substituted for this decisive arts contribution.
Steward removes central armor before blocking capacity fails. A passing armor34 without an actual block falsifies the containment hypothesis.

The fixed 8100/8101 withdrawals require completed hostile duties and resolved dangerous projectiles. If absent, the schedule is falsified; explanatory conditions do not create an unsupported runtime branch.

Deaths are evaluated by absorbed damage, damage dealt and bought time, not prohibited categorically. This selected structure has no credited death handoff: a death releases held enemies, pays no refund and leaves its successor duty unresolved.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions, preserve Fang income, deploy lower medicine first and keep Fang alive until Ansel arrives.
Complete both eastern restraints, establish continuous Steward coverage and survive the first shell sequence. Midnight's delayed arts must not allow protected-target exposure to become lethal.
Heal the second eastern shell sequence, clear paired outer officers, and finish artillery through Steward plus Midnight before its western escape.
Exploit uninterrupted central arts to clear armor before runner accumulation. Deliver the joint medical window and retain all outer interceptions.
Finish final armor, runners and outer officers; use later medical recovery and Midnight's second arts activation for residual central pressure.
Complete western restraints after cooldowns and observe both distinct safe arrivals. The horizon is observational, not an automatic victory declaration.

Ordinary three-capacity blocking; no unsupported talent.
First shell recovery, second lower pass, late mixed pressure and residual clearance.
Reserve the first boost for the second shell pass and Midnight recovery; later boosts cover final outer and central pressure. No probabilistic extra healing.
First arts activation covers western-return artillery and early armor. Second supports residual clearance. Ordinary opening restraint damage is a deliberate, unverified dependency.
Accelerate paired lower officers and later outer pressure while retaining permanent interception.
Automatic enhanced attacks and supported highest-defense priority. No retreat between artillery and central duties.

tactical_thesis: Use seven operators by merging Spot's lower-outer responsibility into a permanently deployed Melantha and direct Hibiscus coverage. Keep Steward continuously deployed at [5,6] DOWN, covering both central holders and the artillery's lower pass. Reserve Midnight's first arts activation for the artillery's western return and central armor, compensating for Steward's incomplete artillery coverage. This is a complete, unsimulated CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE hypothesis; altered healing allocation, eastern restraint clearance and artillery interception remain decisive verification gates.
